visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a short brown bob hairstyle sits at a wooden computer desk in a home office environment. Initially, she wears a vibrant red collared shirt and types enthusiastically on a silver laptop. The camera is positioned at a static medium shot. Her facial expressions are bright and energetic as she looks toward the screen. The background features a computer monitor, a desk lamp, and beige window blinds. (2) The scene cuts to the same woman in the identical position but now wearing a white button-up shirt. Her demeanor has shifted to one of fatigue and stress. She pulls a black wallet from her lap, opens it to show it is empty, and sighs at the camera. The office setting remains unchanged, with the pink mousepad and stationary items visible on the desk. (3) A sequence follows showing her in the red shirt by a dark wooden doorway, dismissively waving off an off-screen request with a cheerful smile. Immediately after, she is seen in the white shirt sitting on a light gray sofa. She checks her smartphone with a surprised expression, then nods vigorously with a wide grin, giving a thumbs-up gesture to indicate acceptance. (4) The woman is now seated comfortably on the gray sofa, hugging a large, round green plushie that features a simple smiley face and pink cheeks. She holds a yellow carton of iced tea and a red can. She takes a sip from the carton and smiles warmly at the camera. A man's hand briefly enters the frame to pat the head of the plushie. (5) The woman walks outside on a sunny urban sidewalk wearing a white shirt and a pink backpack. The shot transitions to her inside a bright supermarket aisle. She pushes a metal shopping cart filled with various Taisun products, including bottled cooking oil, pure water, and canned goods. She points to the items on the shelves with high energy. (6) Graphic overlays depicting a gold bar and a purple iPhone appear floating next to her as she stands in the grocery aisle. She gestures towards her full cart and raises her arms in a celebratory manner. The shelves in the background are densely packed with colorful beverage bottles and assorted retail packages under bright indoor lighting.
